note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (this concept renders a native composition of the role), reused (consumed via shared data/semantics without new composition), not-exercised. Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence: same product behavior, deliberately different composition from the sibling concepts.

entries.variance_notes: FEWER, LARGER cards: 7 icon/title/purpose cards over the 12 categories, each listing its member categories or subgroups as destination rows with counts. Not a 12-tile grid, not a rail, not an editorial list — a broad two-column directory that stays bounded at 2500px.

Exactly one scenario-gated banner (offline/usage-exhausted/invocation-failed/first-run), deduplicated from the compact 2-4 row attention panel beneath the hero search; status words carry tone by weight/underline, never color alone.
No persistent side rail. One sticky beacon bar (named Back pill, breadcrumb, persistent compact search, Close Settings) over a single centered measure; Home is bar-less with a hero search instead.

Roomy result cards (label + kind pill + full path + object note + availability line) in a dropdown anchored under whichever field is active; hot-row keyboard movement; no-results card carries guidance links instead of a dead end.

Airy rows: title + one wrapped explanation + right-aligned control cluster; interactive controls suppress value-echo chips; state notes as an indented line with icon; Details drawer holds scope/related/raw-id.

Summary-first: overview sections become status-card grids (the provider answer block), rosters become item cards with inline honest actions, tabs sit beneath the quick-action row. Deferred owners render as owner-note shells in the same grammar.
Secondary utility here (c07 owns it as primary): five facets + name filter over fixed-height windowed rows (~27 live nodes against 2,828 records under stress); stress fixtures visibly marked.
A page, not a dialog: step rail across the top, selectable category tiles with counts, wide five-column preview table, sticky confirm bar naming the restore point, receipt panel with rollback.
Test affordance, not Settings UI — shared by contract.

entries.concept_component: m.dry rendered through the generic Beacon section renderer
entries.variance_notes: Read-only projection of the shared owner's state; no new composition beyond Beacon's card/row grammar and no fabricated actions.
